item.title: Camp Fire Columbia using chocolate to send kids to camp
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) — There’s a sweet way to help send kids to camp this summer. Camp Fire Columbia is launching a new chocolate fundraiser in partnership with Puyallup Chocolates, with every purchase supporting the nonprofit’s Camper and Family Support Fund. item.title: Bill to move gas tax vote to May primary passes
item.description: The Oregon House has passed a bill that will allow Oregonians to vote earlier on a package that would use a new gas tax to help fund the state's transportation department, and if signed by Gov. Tina Kotek, the vote will take place on May 19.
